thread:
mira_support: Heads up — AcmeCorp procurement replied: they will not accept an official invoice until they send back a signed order acknowledgement and internal authorization token. They explicitly blocked billing until that arrives. :rotating_light:

billing_bot: Invoice INV-2026-045 created in draft state. Status: ON_HOLD (reason: missing customer order acknowledgement).

jessica_am: Do we have a copy of the SOW they referenced? Also who at Acme is the procurement contact?

mira_support: SOW is attached to Zendesk #9872 (link pasted in ticket). Procurement contact is "R. Singh" at acme-procurement; they want a signed order acknowledgement (their format) + PO/authorization id. They said VAT handling needs buyer's cost-center on the PO.

tyler_finance: Understood. To proceed we need: signed order acknowledgement (pdf), PO/authorization id, billing legal name, VAT/Tax ID, and billing address. Can we get a scanned signature or is digital fine?

mira_support: They accept digital signature but insist on buyer's internal token (they called it "BOA token"). I've asked procurement to attach the BOA token and a scanned ack. Waiting on reply.

tyler_finance: If they can't provide the BOA token quickly we can issue a proforma invoice but cannot recognize revenue until a valid PO/ack is on file. Finance prefers the official PO for net30 terms.

jessica_am: I'll ping the AE to escalate on the customer side. For clarity I'm posting the PO fields we require so procurement doesn't reformat and cause another roundtrip: 

```
REQUIRED PO FIELDS:
- PO_NUMBER (buyer format)
- SIGNED_BY (full name)
- SIGNED_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD)
- COST_CENTER / BILLING_ACCOUNT
- VAT_OR_TAX_ID
- BILLING_LEGAL_NAME
```

mira_support: Added that to the ticket. Also provided a sample acknowledgement template. I told them they can upload to the Zendesk ticket or reply here with a secure link.

tyler_finance: Thanks. Once we have the docs, I can clear the hold and trigger invoice issuance. Please tag me in the ticket when file uploaded.

jessica_am: AE confirmed they'll follow up with procurement before EOD PST. I'll update this thread when they respond. :thumbsup:
